title: 💬 Activity, Chat and Reactions
notes: 💬 New Activity tab: every trade (with its grade), add, drop, weekly final and newsletter in one feed, newest first. Filter by Chat, Trades, Moves, Scores or News.
🗣️ League chat lives at the top of Activity. Pick your team, talk your trash, delete your own messages.
🔥 React to anything: trades, moves, finals, matchups, the newsletter, player cards and chat. Tap a reaction to add yours, hold it to see who reacted.
🤡 Make league reactions: a word like FLEECED or a picture, shared with everyone. Inside jokes welcome. Delete your own anytime; the commish can delete any.
